{{Top}}
The '''Inner Rim Mercenaries''' was a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that were founded during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The group decreased in strength after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rise, but expanded during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|104|Inner Rim Mercenaries}}</ref>
